# What does your 401(k) plan really cost, and who is paying for it?

> Free 401(k) plan fee calculator for small-business owners and plan committees: all-in cost as a percent of assets and per participant, recordkeeper, advisor and fund fees, an editable size benchmark, and what the excess costs a participant over 20 years. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
